verdict.rationale: The reviewer's concern is valid. WorkOS documents a customizable hosted UI for authentication (workos-docs-17), and its AuthKit SDKs handle sign-in and sign-up through a hosted flow (workos-docs-57). The Astro SDK ships auth components (workos-docs-58), and Next.js and Laravel integrations exist (workos-docs-59, workos-docs-55). No item shows a prebuilt or hosted profile or account-management UI; storing extra user metadata (workos-docs-30) is an adjacent capability and earns no credit, so one of the story's three required surfaces is unevidenced. missing for 10: prebuilt/hosted profile or account-management UI, detail on how far the hosted UI can be customized, independent or hands-on corroboration of the hosted sign-in/sign-up UI.
